image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a printed restaurant menu. The paper has a warm, beige/sepia tone with visible texture. At the top center is a decorative illustration in red and black ink depicting stylized figures or motifs. Below the illustration are several lines of text arranged in columns, resembling item names and descriptions. The typography appears ornate and somewhat irregular, with varying font weights and styles. Some text is legible (e.g., 'BEAN', 'Pork'), but much of it is distorted, blurred, or nonsensical, suggesting AI-generated gibberish rather than real printed text. There are no clear prices or structured categories visible. The overall layout mimics a vintage or artisanal menu design.

artifact_observations.location: Throughout the body text area, especially mid-to-lower half
artifact_observations.reasoning: Most text strings are semantically meaningless, character combinations are invalid (e.g., 'Mk K5n wne BEAN d10'), and many letters are fused, broken, or morphed. This is severe textual corruption typical of AI generation failure in rendering legible typography.

artifact_observations.location: Top decorative illustration merging with adjacent text lines
artifact_observations.reasoning: The red/black illustration bleeds into the first line of text beneath it. Characters near the bottom edge of the graphic are partially absorbed or distorted, indicating boundary collapse between graphical element and text.

artifact_observations.location: Background paper texture across entire image
artifact_observations.reasoning: Texture appears artificially uniform yet subtly noisy — lacks natural fiber variation or printing imperfections expected in physical menus. Slight smudging around text suggests synthetic blending rather than ink-on-paper realism.

artifact_observations.location: Right edge of frame, where text curves unnaturally
artifact_observations.reasoning: Text along the right margin bends inward as if wrapped around a cylinder, despite the rest of the page appearing flat. This violates planar geometry expectations for a printed sheet viewed at an angle.

artifact_observations.location: Lower-left quadrant, where text lines merge and vanish
artifact_observations.reasoning: Multiple lines of text converge into indistinct blobs; individual characters lose definition and spacing collapses entirely. This indicates failure in maintaining typographic structure under spatial constraints.
